subject.title: chore(messages): guard delegated alias authorization order

question: Should this test-specific callback-order guard be accepted as the intended regression contract for delegated external-plugin message actions?
rationale: The merged repair established the boundary, but this follow-up codifies its exact observable ordering across external plugin hooks; the protected label requires a maintainer to confirm that this is the durable contract.

options.title: Accept the regression contract
options.body: Confirm that rejected delegated aliases must not invoke external resolver or directory hooks, then merge after the proof gate is satisfied.

options.title: Narrow the assertion
options.body: If only a subset of external hooks is part of the supported contract, revise the test to cover that documented boundary without freezing unrelated implementation ordering.

recommendation.title: Accept the regression contract
recommendation.body: Confirm that rejected delegated aliases must not invoke external resolver or directory hooks, then merge after the proof gate is satisfied.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the recently merged compatibility path and this follow-up test, making him the best available technical context source; final contract acceptance remains a maintainer decision.
